cases.title: Initial hidden state of the text box
cases.description: Verify that the text box (data-testid="text-box") is initially hidden on page load without the 'show' class.

cases.title: Toggle visibility using the toggle button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid="toggle-button") toggles the visibility of the text box by adding or removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Rapid repeated clicks handling
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the 'Toggle Text Box' button are handled reliably, ensuring the final visibility state reflects the last user action without inconsistency.

cases.title: Show text box via toggle button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button') makes the text box (data-testid='text-box') visible by adding the 'show' class.

cases.title: Hide text box via close button
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Close' button (data-testid='close-button') inside the visible text box hides the text box by removing the 'show' class.

cases.title: Populate Voice Dropdown on Text Box Open
cases.description: Verify that when the user opens the text box using the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'), the system invokes the getVoices function and populates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') with option elements whose values are set to the voice names and whose display texts show the voice names and languages.

cases.title: Update Voice Dropdown on voiceschanged Event
cases.description: Verify that if available voices change, the system listens for the 'voiceschanged' event and updates the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') accordingly.

cases.title: Assign Selected Voice to Message
cases.description: Verify that when a user selects a voice from the populated dropdown, the selected voice is correctly assigned to message.voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Dropdown populated on page load
cases.description: Verify that the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') is populated with available voices when the page is fully loaded.

cases.title: Select a voice for speech synthesis
cases.description: Verify that users can select a voice from the 'Choose Voice' dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') and the system sets the chosen voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Handle multiple voice selections
cases.description: Verify that the system handles multiple voice selections, ensuring that the last selected voice is set as the active voice for speech synthesis.

cases.title: Support specific language codes
cases.description: Verify that the application supports voice options including specific language codes such as 'CN' for Chinese or 'US' for English and accurately sets the voice containing these codes as the active voice when selected.

cases.title: Read entered text aloud using selected voice
cases.description: Verify that when the user enters text into the textarea (data-testid='text-area'), toggles the text box (data-testid='text-box') via the 'Toggle Text Box' button (data-testid='toggle-button'), and clicks the 'Read Text' button (data-testid='read-button'), the system uses the selected voice from the dropdown (data-testid='voice-select') to read the entered text aloud.

cases.title: Dynamic Generation of Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system dynamically generates predefined phrase boxes in the main section based on a data array, ensuring each box contains an image and a paragraph representing a phrase.

cases.title: Normal Click on Phrase Box for Speech and Visual Feedback
cases.description: Verify that when a user clicks on a phrase box, the system reads the associated text aloud using the Web Speech API and visually highlights the box by adding the active class for 800 milliseconds.

cases.title: Sequential Clicks Across Different Phrase Boxes
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly handles sequential clicks across different phrase boxes, triggering speech playback and visual feedback accurately for each interaction.

cases.title: Rapid Repeated Clicks on the Same Phrase Box
cases.description: Verify that rapid repeated clicks on the same phrase box are handled correctly by the system, ensuring speech playback and visual feedback remain accurate.

opinions.feedback: All requirements and their explicitly described normal, edge, boundary, and rapid click behaviors are fully covered by the provided test cases. No blockers or missing scenario gaps were found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initial hidden state, toggling visibility via click, handling rapid repeated clicks, and boundary conditions. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-2 describes multiple distinct behaviors including toggling the text box via the toggle button and hiding it via the close button by adding/removing the 'show' class. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors including populating the voice dropdown when opened, listening for 'voiceschanged' events, and assigning selected voices to message.voice. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-4 describes multiple distinct behaviors including populating the dropdown on page load, handling multiple voice selections, and supporting specific language codes. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors including entering text into the textarea and reading it aloud via the 'Read Text' button. Requirement e2edev_bench_04-R-6 describes multiple distinct behaviors including dynamically generating phrase boxes, reading associated text on click, visually highlighting with the active class for 800ms, and handling normal, sequential, and rapid clicks.
